map.summary: For this fictional company, purchased equipment above €5,000 needs a valid asset reference for capital expense; missing or incomplete references require a hold for controller review. Purchases at or below €5,000 and all rentals are operating expense. Classification does not authorize payment: duplicates require a hold for controller review, and failed bank verification or changed bank details require a hold for finance review. Review deadlines remain unspecified.
unknowns: Review deadlines and detailed resolution procedures for controller and finance escalations
